large_value.gib_note: the 1024 MiB case raises max_value_size and runs only with REGOLITH_BENCH_HUGE=1

rss.trust_note: RSS for a given configuration is deterministic and independent of host CPU load, so it stays comparable across runs whatever the load guard said.

isolation.note: Every transaction flavor against every isolation level. The level decides how much of a transaction's footprint is validated at commit, so a stricter level refuses more and commits fewer; that refusal is the work it is doing.
